source_snapshot.procedure: Plug USB tools into the ports, boot the OS, install SST, clear BMC SEL and run USB stress for 12 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: SST log and BMC SEL contain no errors.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; dual front USB2 cold/high-rail execution requires a lab operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/IMPROVED; adds both-port mapping, condensation controls, preserved baseline, per-port evidence and warm-up.

old_problem: The pending question consisted of bindable dual-port topology, profile, environmental and error-limit inputs.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits runtime topology/profile bindings, ED-09 keeps cable/chamber actions manual, ED-14 retains 12 hours, ED-15 requires signed per-port limits, and ED-17 forbids erasing baseline evidence.
decision_basis: Directly read Stability row36 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek, GPT/history3074, and row37/history3075.
Both front USB2 connectors require individual tool/cable/hub/controller identity; a result from one port cannot satisfy the other.
The approved profile must state simultaneous or sequential loading and preserve per-port integrity plus reconnect/reset evidence.
Dry 0C soak, calibrated +5% rails, aborts and above-dew-point warm-up establish the safe physical boundary.
Next row37 identity and variant were directly verified; no DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Both front USB2 ports 12-hour stress at 0C and +5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify front USB2 slots 1 and 2 each sustain the approved 12-hour load at cold/high-rail margin without data error, reconnect, shared-hub reset or platform event.
required_package: Slot1/slot2 tool, cable, hub and controller map
Pinned dual-port SST build/profile and integrity volume
Abort, dry warm-up and nominal-restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator establishes the dry 0C/+5% condition, confirms both mapped USB2 tools, runs the signed simultaneous-or-sequential SST profile for the full 12 hours with per-port continuity and integrity telemetry, then performs dry warm-up and nominal restoration.
test_case.expected_result: Both named connectors complete their required coverage with no data mismatch or disallowed reconnect/reset/controller/kernel/SEL event, and nominal post-health is restored safely.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires connector-specific evidence for slots 1 and 2, the approved loading mode and full duration. One port, aggregate SST success, cleared evidence, shortened time or unsigned event limits cannot pass.
safety_gate: Preserve timestamped pre-test logs instead of clearing
Abort for condensation risk, rail/thermal fault, shared-hub instability or data mismatch
No automatic retry; warm above dew point before access
expected_evidence: SST version/profile and per-port enumeration baseline
Kernel/controller/SEL deltas, restoration evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on an abort, preserve both ports' evidence, restore nominal rails, warm/dry above dew point, recover the qualified topology and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The sources consistently require both front USB2 ports; missing runtime limits are not conflicts.

blocked.reason: Purpose, dual-port coverage and recovery are clear; execution is manual.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind both physical paths, SST loading mode/profile, environmental/rail tolerances, per-port error limits and restoration sign-off.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; QUALIFIED MANUAL COLD-CHAMBER EXECUTION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED
